summary: Seal Fate and Cold Blood in Assassination with Puncturing Wounds in Combat, for Backstab on daggers. Shipped as a variant 4.4% behind Combat Daggers.
rotation: Uses the Combat Daggers rotation (no Adrenaline Rush or Blade Flurry talents, so those lines are skipped)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6 s left); spend leftover points in the last 3 s
Backstab right after a main-hand swing (0.25 s), or at 100 energy
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
4-point Eviscerates gained +5.7 at 180 s after the Murder fix
Improved Sinister Strike 2 is a row-filler with no DPS effect
Murder fixed in edd0ff72d to not raise crit damage (-13 to -19 DPS on every build)
Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV) left out under Forever; would add +13 to +18
Grimstitch 4/5-piece bonuses not live on the synthetic gear (about +8 / +6 for Combat Daggers)
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir omitted for consistency (+8 via Dragonbreath Chili)
notes: Spec family set to Assassination (30 Assassination points); the PR frames it as a variant of Combat Daggers and it uses the rogue_combat mksettings setup and the Combat Daggers APL. The talent preset tooltip mentions Blade Flurry, but the talent string has no Blade Flurry point. Bundled gear round (2026-10-13): request regenerated with mksettings on the merged class heads with the same arguments and edits as before; the gear set now carries the two synthetic trinkets, and the rotation uses the on-use trinket on cooldown.
